title: Doing Democracy Better with Iain Walker
discussion_signal: The post discusses building momentum for citizens’ assemblies in New Zealand through collaboration among democracy organizations, treating deliberative institutions as a practical route to better democratic decision-making.
linked_research_question: How can citizens’ assemblies bring time, information, civic lottery, and deliberation into democratic decisions beyond elections?
limits: The post is an advocacy and event discussion rather than an evaluation of an assembly
It does not show participant outcomes or representativeness
The discussion emphasizes potential and momentum rather than implementation failures
